references.text: The same offerings were given by Nahshon, son of Amminadab, as the first tribal leader. This shows the standardized pattern for the dedication offerings.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, gave identical offerings—silver dish, silver bowl, and grain offering—which demonstrates the similarity between the tribes.
The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard weight for the offerings; the same measure is used here.
Description of the grain offering (mincha) with fine flour mixed with oil, which corresponds to the offering in this verse.
Fine flour mixed with oil is also used in other sacrifices, showing continuity in sacrificial practice.
The next tribal leader, Ahira from Naphtali, gave the same offerings, confirming the repeated pattern.
